tools.name: list_materials
tools.description: List the plate materials Steady Steel laser cuts, each with every thickness sold in it (thickness_in, inches), whether it is stocked, and a lead time in business days. Call it before quote_plate: a plate quote takes a material id and a thickness_in exactly as listed here. Empty while plate is not quoted online.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find the pre-designed steel products Steady Steel sells on steadysteel.org/products, by words in their name or description; send no query to list them all. Each lists its tiers: kit (the steel cut to our drawings) and welded (built in our shop), with a firm unit price in CAD cents before HST. Only a tier marked orderable can be quoted. Freight on a kit or a welded unit is quoted by Steady Steel after the order.

tools.name: quote_plate
tools.description: Price one flat plate of steel, stainless or aluminum, laser cut to an outline with holes, slots and bends, at a firm price from the engine behind the plate quoter on steadysteel.org. Every length is inches, +x right and +y up. material and thickness_in must be exactly as list_materials gives them. The outline is a rectangle, circle, ring (a washer) or polygon; holes and bends use its frame, and for a rectangle, circle or ring the origin is the lower-left corner of the box around it. texts adds up to 10 lines of lettering in the same frame, etched or cut through; the words are cut as sent, and a line carrying a link, an address or a phone number is refused. quantity is how many (1 to 999), and quantity_options prices up to five other quantities. A part that cannot be made as asked comes back blocked, with an issue saying why: change it and quote again. Amounts are CAD cents with HST as its own figure, firm until expires_at. Show the person the drawing at preview_url. Nothing is bought here: to order, make a link with create_handoff_link and give it to the person, who checks the part and pays on steadysteel.org.

items.description:
A straight fold across the whole part, on the line through start_in
and end_in ([x, y] in the item's frame; any two points on the line).
angle_deg is how far it folds: 90 is a square bend. direction is up (a
mountain fold seen from above) or down (a valley fold); it does not
change the price.

oneOf.description: One round hole diameter_in across, centred at (x_in, y_in).

count round holes in a row. The first is centred at
(start_x_in, start_y_in) and each one after it is spacing_in further
along angle_deg: 0 runs right, 90 runs up.

A grid of round holes, columns across and rows up, centred on
(center_x_in, center_y_in). The spacings are centre to centre, and
rotation_deg turns the whole grid about its centre, counter-clockwise.

count round holes spaced evenly on a circle bolt_circle_diameter_in
across, centred on (center_x_in, center_y_in). The first hole sits at
start_angle_deg, counter-clockwise from +x.

A slot with round ends, width_in across and length_in from tip to
tip, centred on (center_x_in, center_y_in). angle_deg turns its long
axis counter-clockwise from +x.

A rectangle width_in across and height_in up, its lower-left corner
on the origin.

A round plate diameter_in across. The origin is the lower-left
corner of the square around it, so the centre is at
(diameter_in / 2, diameter_in / 2).

A washer: a round plate with a round bore on the same centre. The
origin is the lower-left corner of the square around it. The wall,
half the difference of the two diameters, must be at least 1/8 in.

A straight-sided outline: its corners in order around the part,
either way round, each [x, y] in inches, 3 to 200 of them. The outline
closes itself; a last corner that repeats the first is dropped. The
corners set the frame, and the item's holes and bends use it too.

items.description:
One line of lettering on the plate. mode is etch (marked into the
face) or cut (stencil letters cut through, the centres held by bridges).
text is up to 40 letters, digits, spaces and common punctuation; cut
letters leave out $, @ and the diameter sign, and no line may carry a
link, a web or email address or a phone number. height_in is the
height of a capital letter: etch from 1/4 in, cut from 1/2 in and
taller on thicker plate, up to 24 in. The line is centred on (x_in,
y_in) in the item's frame and turned angle_deg counter-clockwise from
+x. Cut letters go on plate up to 1/4 in thick. A line that runs off
the part, sits on a hole or another line, or is too small comes back
blocked, with the reason.

tools.name: quote_product
tools.description: Price a catalog product at its firm unit price: the slug and a tier from search_products (kit or welded), only a tier marked orderable. quantity is 1 to 50. Amounts are CAD cents before HST, with HST as its own figure. Freight is quoted by Steady Steel after the order and is not in the quote. Nothing is bought here: to order, make a link with create_handoff_link and give it to the person, who orders and pays on steadysteel.org.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Get a quote quote_plate or quote_product made, by its id, exactly as it was priced. Its status reads expired once it is past expires_at: ask for a new quote then. A quote is kept 30 days past its expiry.

tools.name: create_handoff_link
tools.description: Make the link the person orders from: one page on steadysteel.org showing what was quoted, with a button for each item that opens the page selling it (a plate in the plate quoter, a product on its order page), where they check it and pay. Takes one to ten quote ids, each ready and unexpired, with ten items at most across them: put everything the person is ordering in one link, not a link per quote. Give the person the url. Anyone holding it can open the page, so give it only to them. Nothing is paid through this server.

tools.name: create_rfq_link
tools.description: For work quote_plate and quote_product cannot price (a part from a drawing, a weldment, a repair, plate past the laser): describe the job in words, sizes in inches, and get a link to Steady Steel's quote request form with it filled in. The person adds their own name and contact details there and sends it; Steady Steel replies with a price. Send nothing about the person: a name, email or phone field, or a description carrying a link, a web or email address or a phone number, is refused. The link works for 30 days.
